basic.name: Hurlthorn
basic.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Moze's ATK to a single target enemy.

skill.name: Fleetwinged Raid
skill.description_template: Marks a designated single enemy target as "Prey" and deals to it Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Moze's ATK, and gains 9 points of Charge. When there are no other characters on the field that are capable of combat, Moze cannot use his Skill and dispels the enemy's "Prey" state.

talent.name: Cascading Featherblade
talent.description_template: When "Prey" exists on the field, Moze will enter the Departed state. After allies attack "Prey," Moze will additionally deal 1 instance of Lightning Additional DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of his ATK and consumes 1 point of Charge. For every 3 point(s) of Charge consumed, Moze launches 1 Follow-Up ATK to "Prey," dealing Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling2}}% of his ATK. When Charge reaches 0, dispels the target's "Prey" state and resets the tally of Charge points required to launch Follow-Up ATK. Talent's Follow-Up ATK does not consume Charge.

technique.name: Bated Wings
technique.description: After using Technique, enters the Stealth state for 20 second(s). While in Stealth, Moze is undetectable by enemies. If Moze attacks enemies to enter combat while in Stealth, increases DMG by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

ultimate.name: Dash In, Gash Out
ultimate.description_template: Deals Lightning DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Moze's ATK to a single target enemy, and launches the Talent's Follow-Up ATK against this target. If the target is defeated before this Follow-Up ATK is used, then launches the Follow-Up ATK against a random single enemy instead.

2.name: Nightfeather
2.description: After using Talent's Follow-Up ATK, recovers 1 Skill Point(s). This effect can trigger again after 1 turn(s).

4.name: Daggerhold
4.description: When Moze dispels his Departed state, his action advances by 20%. At the start of each wave, Moze's action advances by 30%.

6.name: Vengewise
6.description: When dealing DMG by using Ultimate, it is considered as having launched a Follow-Up ATK. The Follow-Up ATK DMG taken by the "Prey" increases by 25%.

eidolons.name: Oathkeeper
eidolons.description: After entering battle, Moze regenerates 20 Energy. Each time the Additional DMG from his Talent is triggered, Moze regenerates 2 Energy.

eidolons.name: Wrathbearer
eidolons.description: When all allies deal DMG to the enemy target marked as "Prey," increases CRIT DMG by 40%.

eidolons.name: Deathchaser
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Heathprowler
eidolons.description: When using Ultimate, increases the DMG dealt by Moze by 30%, lasting for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Truthbender
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Faithbinder
eidolons.description: Increases the DMG multiplier of the Talent's Follow-up ATK by 25%.
